claims.statement: CI runs three mise-driven jobs (unit, handshake, live smoke) plus a buildx container job on Ubicloud runners with a version-literal Defold toolchain cache and no cross-version restore-keys fallback.

release-please (python strategy) bumps pyproject.toml [project] version and __init__.py __version__ together, maintains CHANGELOG.md, and a same-run publish-image job pushes ghcr.io/<owner>/defold-mcp with :X.Y.Z, :vX.Y.Z and :latest tags from release-please's outputs using GITHUB_TOKEN (no PAT) — avoiding the dormant separate tag-trigger problem.
Renovate uses native automerge (platformAutomerge false, pr/squash) with four logical groups and majors and vulnerability alerts excluded from automerge.

The Chainguard two-stage Containerfile builds a venv in latest-dev and copies it into the minimal nonroot runtime with a seeded cache directory and ENTRYPOINT defold-mcp, and the defold-mcp CLI exposes skill install and integration install subcommands with the skill force-included into the wheel.
The scheduled OpenWiki CI workflow was removed in favour of manual wiki maintenance.
